context: Use the Parquet tables under data/. See metadata.yaml for paths and context/description.md for field descriptions. Hints are optional and selected by the experiment configuration.
query: As of 2022-11-01, list all projects whose most recent report (dated on or before 2022-11-01) records both a type of 'disaster' and a status of 'not started' and that have accumulated total funding of more than $1,000,000. Accumulated total funding means the sum of all funding amounts granted to that project on or before 2022-11-01.
